fields.Name: T120 - AI Agent Requests
fields.Description: Verifies the Agent Requests section of the AI app renders its log/monitoring view with rows or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Agent Requests section. Confirm the agent request log/monitoring view renders, showing request rows or a valid empty-state. This is a platform view that may have sparse data in a fresh regression DB, so accept an empty-state as long as the view renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI app Agent Requests section is displayed
The view shows an agent request log/monitoring grid with rows or a clear empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
